sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a hunched run, the harpoon held up over his back, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS AND THE HARPOON go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the harpoon with its bone-white blade, orange grip, cyan gem, red ribbon and orange hook, as long as in image 1, raised over his back, drawn back, thrust or thrown as the pale figure holds it; where the pale figure's hand is empty (the harpoon thrown), draw the hand empty. The pale figure of his Q throw (skill) is the old frame's body without its charge glow: do NOT draw the glow. Only him: no water, no mist, no afterimages; the eyes' cyan stays inside the eyes.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under his hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot high off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
